title: BTCUSDT 20 reversal-cycle experiments

execution.stop: 3.0 ATR from actual entry price; gap-aware
execution.cycleExit: RSI >=70, or confirmed regular bearish RSI divergence, or 90-bar time limit
execution.sameBar: OHLC stop is checked on each candle; stop takes precedence over oscillator exits
execution.position: Spot long-only, all available equity, one position at a time

antiLookahead: Regular divergence pivots use left/right confirmation; a pivot at p is only signalled at p+right bars.
Signals formed at candle close execute at the next candle open.
Bearish divergence exits are also delayed until the right-side pivot is confirmed, then exit at the next open.
The current incomplete 4h candle is excluded.
OOS starts 2024-01-01; indicator warm-up uses earlier bars but no OOS outcome is used to set rules.
